Let s = alphahat_0prime*Z + alphahat_1prime*X. Equation (3) is Y = beta_prime*X + theta*D + rho*sigma*MILLS + epsilon. Source-first scope: Section IV Tables 3–4 are the principal full-sample empirical illustration of how selection-model inferences change with exclusion restrictions. Table 4 retains all three stated outcomes (audit fees, cost of equity, going-concern opinions) and the authors’ selection-corrected and OLS/probit comparisons; Table 3 auditor-choice fits are included only because their fitted indices generate the Table 4 MILLS terms. This applies the sweep clarification by selecting the substantive relationship tests before considering the auxiliary MILLS construction.

Tables 1–2 report descriptive survey counts rather than fitted regressions. Table 5 repeats Table 4 specifications in separate Big 5 and non-Big 5 samples; it is a later partition analysis and is excluded under the full-sample scope rule. Section V/Table 6 is a separately labeled replication and sensitivity analysis of Jackson et al. (2009), not part of the selected principal Section IV family, and is excluded. Footnote 6 on physical page 14 also describes untabulated abnormal-accrual analyses, which are not retained.

The 2000–2009 Section IV empirical data source and the Table 3 count are reported; Table 4 does not report outcome-specific observation counts, so its sample_size fields remain null. The matching sample record is linked only to Table 3; it is not used to impute Table 4 counts.

Table 3 does not name the applied first-stage estimator. The general statement that the generic binary-choice equation is usually estimated by probit, the pseudo-R², and test statistics do not identify the Table 3 estimator; it remains unknown.

The supplied verified reading includes an independently checked coordinator transcription of the generic physical-page-3 inverse Mills equation. MILLS formulas use that supplied transcription and its provenance; no new math derivative was made. The table-specific outcome equations are reported by tables, so equation_text remains null.

The Table 4 Panel A Column 6 size-control description conflicts: page 10 prose says LnTA, while the specific Table 4 note on page 12 assigns LnSale. The RHS follows the specific table note and the conflict is preserved here.

The Table 4 Panel B beta and volatility controls are built from daily-return regressions described in the variable notes. This supporting firm-year fit is added; the paper does not name its estimator or report per-fit daily counts.
